// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  internals/_internal.scss — the .internal chrome itself: title, content
//  column, media sizing contracts (--mf-w/--mf-h for <media-figure>),
//  expand control, footer panel, and the note-dot-pulse keyframes.
//  Imported by internals.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Internals chrome — project detail + legal pages: title, content column, media contracts, footer panel.
.internal {
  &-title {
    @extend %TTL_BASE;
    @extend %TTL_LG;
    @extend %TTL_BASE;
    @extend %TTL_SPECIAL;

    padding: var(--space-4xl) var(--space-xl) var(--space-2xl);
    text-align: center;

    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: var(--space-4xl) 0 var(--space-3xl);
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding: var(--space-5xl);
    }
  }

  &-main {
    @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    // No max-height/overflow here — the section must not clip its own padding.
    // The 70vh constraint lives inside the media-figure Shadow DOM (figure element).
    padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-xl);
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);
    // Skip layout/paint while off-screen — the media figure is the page's
    // heaviest paint, and scroll spends its frame budget re-rendering
    // sections that aren't visible. `auto` remembers the real size after
    // first render; the vh estimate only sizes the pre-render placeholder.
    content-visibility: auto;
    contain-intrinsic-size: auto 70vh;

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: var(--space-3xl) var(--space-3xl);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: var(--space-4xl) var(--space-5xl);
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding: var(--space-5xl) var(--space-6xl);
    }

    figure {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      max-height: 70vh;
      max-height: 70dvh;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 0 auto;
      -webkit-border-radius: var(--space-md);
      border-radius: var(--space-md);

      @include layout-1024() {
        -webkit-border-radius: var(--space-lg);
        border-radius: var(--space-lg);
      }
    }

    .render-placeholder {
      display: block;
      position: relative;
      height: auto;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;

      @include layout-768() {
        width: auto;
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: 70vh;
        max-height: 70dvh;
      }
    }

    .render-media {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
      object-fit: cover;

      &--thumb {
        filter: blur(12px);
        transform: scale(1.05);
        z-index: 1;
        // Mobile: filter:blur triggers paint every frame — extremely expensive on mobile GPU.
        // Replace with a simple opacity dim while the hi-res loads.
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
          filter: none;
          transform: none;
          opacity: 0.4;
        }
      }

      &--high {
        opacity: 0;
        z-index: 2;
        transition: opacity 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

        &.render-media--loaded {
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        border-radius: var(--space-lg);
      }
    }
  }

  // Cover skeleton (before data loads)
  .skeleton-cover {
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      var(--skel-bg-1) 25%,
      var(--skel-bg-2) 50%,
      var(--skel-bg-3) 75%
    );
    background-size: 200% 100%;
    animation: skeleton-shimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    display: block;
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      animation: none;
      background: var(--skel-bg-1);
    }
  }

  &-description {
    @extend %MAXAREA;

    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-top: var(--space-2xl);
    padding-bottom: var(--space-xl);
    // Min-height matches the carousel item height, set as a CSS var by Carousel.vue
    min-height: var(--carousel-item-height, auto);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    contain: layout style;
    // Off-screen description blocks skip render entirely; the draw-text
    // fit inside no-ops on zero-size reads and re-fits via RO on reveal.
    content-visibility: auto;
    contain-intrinsic-size: auto 60vh;

    @include layout-768() {
      // 1 col indent per side on 8-col grid (1/8 = 12.5%)
      padding-top: var(--space-4xl);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
      padding-left: 12.5%;
      padding-right: 12.5%;
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      // 3 cols indent per side on 12-col grid (3/12 = 25%) → content in cols 4–9
      padding-top: var(--space-4xl);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
      padding-left: 25%;
      padding-right: 25%;
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding-top: var(--space-5xl);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      padding-top: var(--space-6xl);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-4xl);
    }

    .legal & {
      // Legal pages: keep the column-indent padding so content sits in
      // cols 4–9 (3 empty cols on each side of the 12-column grid).
      // The .legal container is full-width (no %MAXAREA), so this
      // 25% padding IS the only source of indentation.
      @include layout-768() {
        padding-top: var(--space-xl);
        padding-bottom: var(--space-xl);
        // 12.5% = 1.5 cols on 8-col intermediate grid
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding-top: var(--space-xl);
        padding-bottom: var(--space-xl);
        // 25% already applied by base rule — no override needed
      }

      @include layout-1920() {
        padding-top: var(--space-2xl);
        padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
      }

      @include layout-2560() {
        padding-top: var(--space-3xl);
        padding-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
      }
    }

    &:last-of-type {
      .legal & {
        @include layout-1024() {
          padding-bottom: var(--space-4xl);
        }

        @include layout-1920() {
          padding-bottom: var(--space-5xl);
        }

        @include layout-2560() {
          padding-bottom: var(--space-6xl);
        }
      }
    }

    &-text {
      @extend %TXT_BASE;
      @extend %TXT_MD;

      font-family: var(--font-primary);
      font-weight: 250;
      word-break: normal;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
      hyphens: none;
      padding-bottom: var(--space-lg);

      @include layout-768() {
        padding-bottom: var(--space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding-bottom: var(--space-xl);
      }

      a {
        @extend %LK_LINK;

        text-decoration: none;
        color: var(--black);
      }
    }

    p:last-of-type {
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }
  }

  &-extra {
    @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);
    overflow-x: auto;
    scroll-snap-align: center;
    // The media strip is the second-heaviest paint — skip it while the
    // section itself is off-screen (horizontally off-view items are
    // already clipped by the overflow container).
    content-visibility: auto;
    contain-intrinsic-size: auto 70vh;

    /* width */
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      height: var(--space-md);

      @include layout-1024() {
        height: var(--space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-2560() {
        height: var(--space-xl);
      }
    }

    /* Track */
    &::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: var(--black);
    }

    /* Handle */
    &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      border-radius: to-rem(3);
      background: var(--grey-3);
    }

    /* Handle on hover */
    &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: var(--grey);
    }

    &-scroll {
      padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-xl) calc(var(--space-2xl) - var(--space-md));
      display: block;
      white-space: nowrap;
      width: max-content;
      margin: 0 auto;

      @include layout-768() {
        padding: var(--space-5xl) var(--space-3xl) calc(var(--space-5xl) - var(--space-lg));
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding: var(--space-3xl) var(--space-3xl) calc(var(--space-3xl) - var(--space-lg));
      }

      @include layout-1440() {
        padding: var(--space-4xl) var(--space-4xl) calc(var(--space-4xl) - var(--space-lg));
      }

      @include layout-1920() {
        padding: var(--space-5xl) var(--space-5xl) calc(var(--space-5xl) - var(--space-lg));
      }

      @include layout-2560() {
        padding: var(--space-5xl) var(--space-5xl) calc(var(--space-5xl) - var(--space-xl));
      }
    }

    &-item {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--space-md);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      display: inline-block;
      width: min-content;
      padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
      min-height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;

      @include layout-768() {
        padding: 0 var(--space-xl);
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        border-radius: var(--space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-1440() {
        padding: 0 var(--space-2xl);
      }

      @include layout-1920() {
        padding: 0 var(--space-3xl);
      }

      &:first-of-type {
        padding-left: 0;
      }

      &:last-of-type {
        padding-right: 0;
      }

      // ── CSS Custom Properties for media-figure Shadow DOM sizing ──────────────
      // CSS custom properties DO cross shadow boundaries — this is the only way
      // to pass sizing context into <media-figure>'s encapsulated shadow root.
      // media-figure.scss reads --mf-w / --mf-h / --mf-max-w to size the placeholder.
      media-figure,
      figure {
        --mf-w: calc(90vw - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)});
        --mf-h: calc(70vh - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)});
        --mf-h: calc(70dvh - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)});

        @include layout-768() {
          --mf-w: calc(90vw - #{calc(var(--space-2xl) * 2)});
          --mf-h: calc(70vh - #{calc(var(--space-2xl) * 2)});
          --mf-h: calc(70dvh - #{calc(var(--space-2xl) * 2)});
        }

        @include layout-1024() {
          --mf-w: var(--space-6xl);
          --mf-h: var(--space-7xl);
        }

        @include layout-1440() {
          --mf-w: var(--space-7xl);
          --mf-h: var(--space-8xl);
        }

        @include layout-2560() {
          --mf-w: var(--space-8xl);
          --mf-h: var(--space-9xl);
        }
      }

      figure {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        width: var(--mf-w);
        height: var(--mf-h);
        max-width: var(--mf-max-w, none);
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--space-md);
        margin: 0;

        @include layout-1024() {
          border-radius: var(--space-lg);
        }

        .render-placeholder {
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          object-fit: cover;
        }

        // Skeleton slides: overlay the placeholder instead of flowing below it
        .skeleton--media {
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
        }
      }

      // landscape variant: the vw cap travels in --mf-w (consumed as the
      // placeholder's max-width) so wide media can use most of the viewport;
      // --mf-max-w mirrors it for the light-DOM figure skeleton contract.
      &.landscape media-figure {
        @include layout-1024() {
          --mf-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-3xl));
          --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-3xl));
        }

        @include layout-1280() {
          --mf-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-4xl));
          --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-4xl));
        }

        @include layout-1440() {
          --mf-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-7xl));
          --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-7xl));
        }

        @include layout-1920() {
          --mf-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-6xl));
          --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-6xl));
        }
      }

      // small variant
      &.small media-figure {
        @include layout-1440() {
          --mf-w: var(--space-6xl);
          --mf-h: var(--space-8xl);
        }

        @include layout-2560() {
          --mf-w: var(--space-7xl);
          --mf-h: var(--space-9xl);
        }
      }

      label {
        @extend %TTL_BASE;
        @extend %TTL_XS;

        display: block;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin: 0;
        font-variant: all-small-caps;
        color: var(--color-white-raw);
      }

      &-open {
        display: none;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        position: fixed;
        background: rgba($color-black, 0.9);
        min-height: 100vh;
        min-height: 100dvh;
        height: auto;
        width: 100vw;
        z-index: 1;

        img {
          box-sizing: border-box;
          padding: var(--space-5xl);
          height: auto;
          width: 100%;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  &-expand {
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in;
    cursor: pointer;

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      opacity: 0.95;
    }
  }

  &-footer {
    // Same off-screen skip as the other sections — the related-cards
    // strip renders nothing until it nears the viewport.
    content-visibility: auto;
    contain-intrinsic-size: auto 80vh;

    &-title {
      @extend %TTL_BASE;
      @extend %TTL_LG;
      @extend %TTL_BASE;
      @extend %TTL_SPECIAL;

      max-width: var(--space-8xl);
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
      padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-xl) var(--space-lg);

      span {
        display: inline-block;
        text-align: center;
      }

      @include layout-768() {
        padding: var(--space-3xl) var(--space-3xl) var(--space-2xl);
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding: var(--space-5xl) var(--space-5xl) var(--space-2xl);
      }
    }

    &-related {
      @extend %MAXAREA;

      width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding-top: var(--space-xl);
      padding-bottom: var(--space-4xl);

      @include layout-768() {
        padding-top: var(--space-2xl);
        padding-bottom: var(--space-5xl);
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding-top: var(--space-3xl);
        padding-bottom: var(--space-5xl);
      }
    }

    &-items {
      @extend %TTL_BASE;
      @extend %TTL_XS;

      // Full-bleed footer stripe spanning the whole viewport width — the
      // links row and the legal disclaimer share the grid's max area.
      box-sizing: border-box;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: var(--space-2xl);
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-5xl);
      }

      &-separator {
        padding: 0 var(--space-md);
        display: none;

        @include layout-375() {
          display: inline-block;
        }

        @include layout-2560() {
          padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
        }
      }

      // Animated hairline between the socials row and the disclaimer
      // note — a soft sheen travels the line on a slow loop so the split
      // reads alive rather than a static rule. The hr's own margins
      // carry the extra breathing room requested between the two zones.
      &-divider {
        @extend %MAXAREA;

        display: block;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        width: 100%;
        height: var(--space-3xs);
        margin: var(--space-2xl) auto var(--space-xl);
        padding: 0;
        border: none;
        border-radius: var(--radius-round);
        // Static hairline — the traveling accent band lives on ::after so
        // the sweep is a composited transform, not a per-frame repaint.
        background: linear-gradient(
          90deg,
          transparent,
          var(--border-color) 12%,
          var(--border-color) 88%,
          transparent
        );

        &::after {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
          width: 25%;
          background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--color-accent) 50%, transparent);
          transform: translateX(-110%);
          animation: internal-footer-divider-sheen 7s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
          &::after {
            animation: none;
          }
        }

        // Shadow DOM: the store-driven html.reduced-motion flag can't
        // pierce the boundary — host-context mirrors the media query.
        :host-context(html.reduced-motion) & {
          &::after {
            animation: none;
          }
        }

        // WebGPU sheen live — the rust/divider-sheen canvas draws the
        // whole divider (hairline + traveling band); the <hr>'s own
        // paint hides but keeps its box so the overlay stays
        // measurable.
        &:has(+ .internal-footer-items-divider-canvas:not(.is-fallback)) {
          visibility: hidden;
        }

        @include layout-1024() {
          margin-top: var(--space-3xl);
        }
      }

      // The divider's WebGPU overlay canvas — absolutely positioned
      // over the <hr>'s box by the mount helper (inline
      // left/top/width/height).
      &-divider-canvas {
        position: absolute;
        display: block;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      @keyframes internal-footer-divider-sheen {
        from {
          transform: translateX(-110%);
        }

        to {
          transform: translateX(440%);
        }
      }

      &-link {
        @extend %TTL_BASE;
        @extend %TTL_XS;
        @extend %LK_LINK;

        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: block;
        width: fit-content;
        margin-inline: auto;
        // The %LK_LINK underline is a border-bottom — keep the line box
        // tight so it hugs the baseline; block spacing rides on margins.
        margin-block: var(--space-md);
        line-height: var(--space-xl);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-weight: 300;

        @include layout-375() {
          text-transform: initial;
          display: inline-block;
          width: auto;
        }

        &.router-link-active {
          opacity: 1;
          border-bottom-color: var(--color-accent);
          cursor: pointer;
        }
      }

      &-note {
        @extend %TTL_BASE;
        @extend %TTL_XXS;
        @extend %MAXAREA;

        // Collapsed: -note-text is justified and clamped to its first line
        // (CSS ellipsis); -note-more renders three dots that pulse while the
        // note is truncated — the "show more" affordance. The element is a
        // real <button> so Enter/Space expand it (aria-expanded + :focus-visible).
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: var(--space-2xs);
        clear: both;
        width: 100%;
        padding: 0;
        border: none;
        margin: var(--space-md) auto var(--space-lg);
        font-family: inherit;
        font-weight: 300;
        line-height: var(--space-xl);
        text-align: left;
        color: inherit;
        background: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        // Mobile reads better capitalized (the authored sentence case);
        // the uppercase treatment resumes at tablet/desktop widths.
        text-transform: none;

        @include layout-768() {
          text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        &-text {
          display: -webkit-box;
          -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
          -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
          line-clamp: 1;
          overflow: hidden;
          flex: 1 1 auto;
          min-width: 0;
          text-align: justify;
          text-align-last: left;
          text-decoration: underline;
          text-decoration-color: transparent;
          text-underline-offset: var(--space-3xs);
          transition: text-decoration-color 0.35s ease;
        }

        // Trailing "···" affordance — a bordered pill so it reads as a
        // control, not typographic ellipsis; hidden until JS measures real
        // truncation (is-truncated); dots pulse in a staggered wave.
        &-more {
          flex: none;
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          align-self: center;
          gap: var(--space-xs);
          padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm);
          border: var(--space-3xs) solid var(--border-color);
          border-radius: var(--radius-round);
          transform: translateY(var(--space-3xs));
          opacity: 0;
          transition:
            opacity 0.3s ease,
            transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
            border-color 0.3s ease;
        }

        &-dot {
          width: var(--space-xs);
          height: var(--space-xs);
          border-radius: var(--radius-round);
          background: currentColor;
          animation: note-dot-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;

          &:nth-child(2) {
            animation-delay: 0.25s;
          }

          &:nth-child(3) {
            animation-delay: 0.5s;
          }
        }

        &.is-truncated &-more {
          opacity: 0.85;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }

        &.is-open {
          display: block;
        }

        &.is-open &-text {
          display: block;
          overflow: visible;
          text-decoration: none;
        }

        &.is-open &-more {
          display: none;
        }

        &:hover,
        &:focus-visible {
          color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
        }

        &:hover &-text,
        &:focus-visible &-text {
          text-decoration-color: currentColor;
        }

        &:hover &-more,
        &:focus-visible &-more {
          opacity: 1;
          border-color: var(--border-item-hover);
        }

        &:active &-more {
          transform: translateY(0) scale(0.92);
        }
      }

      // Authorship block — sits under the second animated divider in both
      // loaded and skeleton socials states. Centered, muted via the
      // theme-aware secondary ink (AAA-safe on --bg-secondary).
      &-credit,
      &-rights {
        @extend %TTL_BASE;
        @extend %TTL_XXS;

        width: 100%;
        margin: 0 auto;
        text-align: center;
        color: var(--text-secondary);
        line-height: var(--space-xl);
        // Quiet colophon, not small caps — drop %TTL_XXS's uppercase and
        // set the authorship copy in italic instead.
        text-transform: none;
        font-style: italic;
      }

      &-credit {
        max-width: var(--space-9xl);
        margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
      }
    }

    // Docs-portal entry — a dedicated footer area below the legal links:
    // untranslated English title, localized "English only" description.
    &-docs {
      @extend %TTL_BASE;
      @extend %TTL_XS;

      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3xs);
      width: 100%;
      padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-2xl) var(--space-xl);
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);

      &-link {
        @extend %TTL_BASE;
        @extend %TTL_XS;
        @extend %LK_LINK;

        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: none;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-weight: 300;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      &-desc {
        @extend %TTL_BASE;
        @extend %TTL_XXS;

        opacity: 0.7;
      }
    }
  }
}

// Three-dot pulse for the disclaimer "more" affordance — each dot eases
// between dim and full ink; nth-child delays stagger the wave.
@keyframes note-dot-pulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 0.25;
  }

  50% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
